editorApprovedScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: By explicit editorial approval, this assessment scores only Michael Shermer and Glen Scrivener across the complete substantive exchange. Moderator Vince Vitale supplies substantive philosophical questions and challenges beyond the ordinary incidental-host allowance; his contributions remain context, and the debaters’ own replies remain eligible for assessment. editorApprovedScope.scopeInterpretation: Both speakers allow moral conduct without belief in God. The contested issues include moral grounding, the scope of equal human worth, and the historical and continuing role of Christianity. Scrivener also allows some objective or prosocial morality without Jesus; do not invent his denial of every secular moral truth.
